name: Frontend Polish
description: 优化界面细节、响应式状态和视觉一致性。Use for refining spacing, hover/focus/loading/empty states, transitions, and cross-breakpoint consistency.

promptPatterns: \b(frontend polish|界面打磨|ui polish|优化.*细节|visual consistency|响应式状态)\b

commands.injectPrompt: Apply the frontend-polish skill: audit and refine interface details — spacing rhythm, interactive states (hover/focus/active/disabled/loading/empty/error), motion, and visual consistency across breakpoints.
